info.name: Scenario: Creating an Emergency Calling Service (2026-11-19)
info.description:
Registers a DID for emergency calling. The DID supports emergency calling and is not registered yet. The emergency requirement of its country and number type tells which identity and address details are needed. An identity and an address that meet the requirement are validated and submitted in an emergency verification; the verification creates a new emergency calling service.

Learn more: [Register Emergency Calling Service](https://doc.didww.com/api3/examples/register-emergency-calling-service.html).

> ### Attention
>
> The requests run against the environment you select: the optional steps create an identity and an address, and **Create Emergency Verification** submits the DID for review. Send them one by one, or run the collection in the Collection Runner: each request selects the next one when its test passes.

#### Using this collection

1. Fork the collection together with the **DIDWW Sandbox** or **DIDWW Production** environment and select the environment.
2. Put your API key into the `apiKey` variable of the environment as its *current value*. Keep forked environments private.
3. Send the first request. The collection mints an access token with your API key (`POST https://{{authHost}}/token`) and reuses it until shortly before it expires. When minting fails, the request reports the reason as a script error.

#### Environment variables

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `host` | API host, for example `sandbox-api.didww.com` |
| `authHost` | Host of the token service, for example `auth-sandbox.didww.com` |
| `apiKey` | Your DIDWW API key |

#### Collection variables

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `did.id` | ID of the DID to register for emergency calling |
| `country.id` | Country ID of the DID group of the DID |
| `number_type` | Number type of the DID group of the DID, for example `local` |
| `emergency_requirement.id` | Emergency requirement ID for the country and number type |
| `identity.id` | ID of the identity used for the emergency verification |
| `address.id` | ID of the address of the identity |
| `emergency_verification.id` | ID of the created emergency verification |
| `emergency_calling_service.id` | ID of the emergency calling service created with the verification |
| `apiVersion` | The API version the token selects: `2026-11-19` |
| `tokenScope` | `full` (the default) or `read` |
| `accessToken`, `accessTokenExpiresAt`, `accessTokenFingerprint`, `accessTokenError` | Set by the collection; do not edit them |

request.description:
**Step 4.** Optional: create an identity in the country of the DID that meets the emergency requirement and save it in `identity.id`. Skip this step when the DID already has an identity (step 1): the verification must use it. Replace the example values first; when the requirement asks for a business identity, send `identity_type` `business` with the company details.

Create single Identity owned by your account.

## Request

HTTP Method: `POST`

URI Path: `/v3/identities/`

### Request Body Object Attributes

**Personal**

| Name | Type | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| first\_name | `string` | Yes | First name of the personal identity. |
| last\_name | `string` | Yes | Last name of the personal identity. |
| phone\_number | `string` | Yes | Phone number of the personal identity. Only digits allowed. |
| personal\_tax\_id | `string` | No | Personal tax ID of the personal identity. |
| birth\_date | `string` | No | Birth date of the personal identity in ISO 8601 format. |
| id\_number | `string` | No | ID number of the personal identity. |
| description | `string` | No | Description of the personal identity. |
| external\_reference\_id | `string` | No | Identifier for identity in external system |
| identity\_type | `string` | Yes | Type of identity. Write `personal` to create a personal identity. |
| contact\_email | `string` | No | Contact email address of identity. Must be a valid email address. |

`company_website` is not accepted for a personal identity: sending a value returns `422 Unprocessable Entity`.

**Business**

| Name | Type | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| company\_name | `string` | Yes | Company name of the business identity. |
| company\_website | `string` | No | Company website of the business identity. Can be `null`. |
| company\_reg\_number | `string` | No | Company registration number of the business identity. |
| vat\_id | `string` | No | Company VAT ID of the business identity. Listed as `tax_id` in the mandatory fields of the address and emergency requirements. |
| first\_name | `string` | Yes | Company's representative First name of the business identity. |
| last\_name | `string` | Yes | Company's representative Last name of the business identity. |
| phone\_number | `string` | Yes | Company's representative Phone number of the business identity. Only digits allowed. |
| personal\_tax\_id | `string` | No | Company's representative Tax ID of the business identity. |
| birth\_date | `string` | No | Company's representative Birth date of the business identity in ISO 8601 format. |
| id\_number | `string` | No | Company's representative ID number of the business identity. |
| description | `string` | No | Company's representative description of the business identity. |
| external\_reference\_id | `string` | No | Identifier for identity in external system. |
| identity\_type | `string` | Yes | Identity type. Write `business` to create a business identity. |
| contact\_email | `string` | No | Contact email address of identity. Must be a valid email address. |

### Request Body Object Relationships

| Title | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| country | [Country Object](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/coverage-resources/countries/country-object.html#country-object-v35) | Specifies the country for identity. Required when `vat_id` is set. |

**Step 8.** Submit the DID with the address for review and save the verification in `emergency_verification.id`. The verification creates a new emergency calling service. Add `callback_url` and `callback_method` to be notified when the status changes.

Creates a new emergency verification, either for a new Emergency Calling Service or for
resubmitting a rejected or updating an existing one.

## Request

HTTP Method: `POST`

URI Path: `/v3/emergency_verifications`

### Request Body Object Attributes

| Name | Type | Is Required? | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| callback\_url | `string` | No | The HTTP or HTTPS endpoint to where events related to the verification will be delivered. |
| callback\_method | `string` | No | The callback method used for verification events. Supported methods: `post`, `get`. Required when `callback_url` is provided. |
| external\_reference\_id | `string` | No | Optional identifier for the emergency verification in the customer's external system. Maximum length is 100 characters. |

See [Emergency Verification callback details](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/callbacks-details.html#callbacks-emergency-verification-v35)
for information about `callback_url`, `callback_method`, and the callback payload.

### Request Body Object Relationships

| Title | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| address | [Addresses](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/regulation-resources/addresses/address-object.html#addresses-object-v35) | Specifies the emergency address ID. |
| dids | [DID](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/inventory-resources/did/did-object.html#did-object-v35) | Specifies the DID IDs for a new Emergency Calling Service. At least one DID is required when `emergency_calling_service` is not provided. |
| emergency\_calling\_service | [Emergency Calling Service](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/emergency-resources/emergency-calling-services/emergency-calling-service-object.html#emergency-calling-service-object-v35) | Specifies the existing Emergency Calling Service ID when resubmitting or updating the address of an existing service. |

> **Note**
>
> - New Calling Service mode uses `address` and `dids` relationships and does not send `emergency_calling_service`.
> - Existing Calling Service mode uses `emergency_calling_service` and `address` relationships and does not send `dids`.
> - Address updates are allowed only when the Emergency Calling Service status is `new`, `changes_required`, or `active`.
> - Requests return `422` when the Emergency Calling Service is in `pending_update`, `in_process`, or `canceled` status.

| 400 | No | [Bad Request](https://doc.didww.com/api3/specification/errors/index.html#api-bad-request) |

Also returned when the access token carries the `read` scope, which does not cover this method (title `Insufficient scope`, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope"`). See [Scopes](https://doc.didww.com/api3/2026-11-19/authentication.html#authentication-scopes-v35). |

| 429 | No | The request budget of the account for the current window is spent (`too_many_requests`). `Retry-After` gives the number of seconds to wait. |
